text:
incident-bot: PAGED: deploy-canary-failure [sev=high] - canary group 'canary-us-west-1' returning 502/503 for embed-service after 23:45 UTC. Trigger: 5% error rate over 2m. Pager: SRE rotation.

pagerduty-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-4321. Acknowledgement required. Escalation policy: SRE-oncall -> Team Lead -> Eng-Shift.

sre-lee: acked. looking into it. pulling canary logs now. :eyes:

oncall-sam: I got the page, oncall switching to incident channel. anyone see release notes that align?

eng-alex: rolled out v2.14.3 to canary 02 at 23:40 UTC - contains tokenizer/embedding change. tagging in case it's related.

pm-jordan: customer impact? any user-facing errors reported? support queue shows 4 customers mentioning failed uploads in the last 10m.

support-ana: flagging two enterprise customers (Acme Corp, CloudNova) with errors 502 during embed calls. raised support ticket IDs: 8732, 8733.

sre-lee: quick sanity checks: canary instances are healthy at infra level, but proxy logs show `upstream prematurely closed connection` and backend pods show 503s. grabbing pprof traces and heap info.

eng-alex: sounds like a runtime regression in v2.14.3 - we've seen similar during quant path changes. can we isolate traffic and rollback?

sre-lee: Suggestion: divert traffic away from canary pool to stable, keep canary offline. I'll apply traffic-split to 0% for canary.

oncall-sam: applying quick traffic shift now: `redwood-cli rollout traffic --service embed-service --from canary-us-west-1 --to stable-us-west-1 --percent 100`

incident-bot: Command accepted: applying traffic shift.

eng-alex: also request to scale down canary pods to 0 to avoid retries: `kubectl scale deploy/embed-canary --replicas=0 -n prod`

pm-jordan: please make sure to notify support and customers in-flight. Ana, can you post a quick note?

support-ana: posting update to affected customers: "We're seeing transient 502/503 errors for embedding calls in us-west. We're routing traffic to stable nodes and investigating. We'll send another update in 15 minutes."

pagerduty-bot: INC-2026-4321 acknowledged by sre-lee at 23:47 UTC.

eng-alex: looking at logs: error stack points to new tokenizer fallback path hitting OOM in quantized path: `runtime: out of memory` from node ai-worker-3. Heap jump correlated with incoming long prompts.

oncall-sam: can we hotfix config to cap prompt length at edge? Maybe immediate mitigation: apply request size limit via ingress.

eng-alex: can do. `kubectl apply -f ingress-rate-limit.yaml` with `max-body-size: 1MB` and short timeouts. Deploying now.

incident-bot: ingress config rollout succeeded.

pm-jordan: customer comms updated: "We've applied a routing and ingress mitigation to reduce errors. No rollback yet; team investigating root cause. We'll provide ETA for resolution in 30 minutes."

sre-lee: traffic shift completed, stable pool absorbing all traffic. error rate on embed-service dropped from 5% -> 0.4% in the last 2m. telemetry confirming reductions.

eng-alex: reproducer found: long prompt length + quantized tokenizer leads to memory spike on that variant. safe rollback plan: revert canary deploy v2.14.3 -> v2.14.2 on canary group, then gradually re-enable canary. Recommend rollback rather than hotpatch.

oncall-sam: do we need PD escalation to team lead? current severity seems contained but customers hit. Any reason to escalate?

sre-lee: Not yet. We'll keep incident open and coordinate rollback. If error rate goes above 1% again or more customers affected, escalate.

eng-alex: initiating canary rollback: `redwood-cli deploy revert --service embed-service --target-version v2.14.2 --target canary-us-west-1`

incident-bot: Rollback job queued. Progress updates will follow.

eng-alex: rollback succeeded on canary group. bringing canary back to 0% then 10% traffic for smoke.

sre-lee: monitoring p99/p95 and error surface. so far stable at 0.2% and no new enterprise errors reported.

pm-jordan: great. prepping post-incident note. need root-cause write-up from eng for customers. Alex can you provide a short summary for support?

eng-alex: summary for customers: "A canary release (v2.14.3) introduced a tokenizer memory regression for quantized inference paths which could surface as 502/503 on long prompts. We rolled back the canary and applied ingress mitigations. A full fix (limit allocation & protective guardrails in tokenizer) will be released in the next patch."

support-ana: I'll send to affected customers and link support tickets.

oncall-sam: marking incident as 'mitigated' but keeping thread open for postmortem. please add any follow-ups.

eng-alex: follow-ups: add automated alert for tokenizer OOM traces, add pre-rollout perf check for quantized path with long inputs, and add canary memory guard.

pm-jordan: assigning postmortem owners: eng-alex (RC), sre-lee (mitigation timeline), support-ana (customer comms).

incident-bot: INC-2026-4321 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Will auto-close if stable for 60m.

sre-lee: thanks team. good coordination. dropping off. :pray:

oncall-sam: closing oncall handover to next rotation. all good from my side.

pm-jordan: leaving notes for postmortem doc: include traffic diversion command history, ingress yaml, rollback command, support ticket IDs, and timeline.

support-ana: confirmed customers notified, closing support tickets pending final fix.

eng-alex: will create fix branch and PR today.

incident-bot: Thread will be archived after incident closure.
